Name: Stardew PvZ Weapons
Author: lianyilipper
Description:
Electric Gatling Pea - Stardew Valley Weapon Mod
Electric Gatling Pea is a custom slingshot weapon inspired by the iconic Gatling Pea from Plants vs. Zombies 2. This powerful ranged weapon brings electrifying combat to Stardew Valley!
Features[list]
[*]Rapid Fire Attack: Each click fires 4 piercing electric bullets that deal 50 damage and stun enemies on hit
[*]Piercing Projectiles: Bullets pass through multiple enemies and obstacles, maximizing damage potential
[*]Ultimate Ability: 30% chance to trigger an electric burst, unleashing 210 bullets over 1.5 seconds in a spread pattern that follows your mouse cursor
[*]Destructive Mode: Press V to toggle destructive mode, allowing bullets to destroy trees, rocks, and other obstacles
[*]Extended Range: Double the range of standard slingshots for superior battlefield control
[/list]Crafting Recipe
Craft at any crafting station:
[list]
[*]Battery Pack ×5
[*]Iridium Bar ×10
[/list]Controls[list]
[*]Left Click: Fire electric bullets
[*]V Key: Toggle destructive mode
[/list]This weapon combines the nostalgic PvZ2 aesthetic with Stardew Valley's combat system, featuring custom bullet textures and electric arc effects. Perfect for players who want a powerful, fun ranged option for combat!
电能超级机枪射手 - 星露谷物语武器模组电能超级机枪射手 是一款自定义弹弓武器，灵感来自《植物大战僵尸2》中的超级机枪射手。这款强大的远程武器为星露谷物语带来了电光火石般的战斗体验！
功能特性[list]
[*]连射攻击：每次点击发射4枚穿透电能子弹，造成50点伤害并眩晕敌人
[*]穿透弹道：子弹可穿透多个敌人和障碍物，最大化伤害输出
[*]终极技能：30%概率触发电能爆发，在1.5秒内散射发射210枚子弹，散射方向跟随鼠标移动
[*]破坏模式：按V键切换，可破坏树木、岩石等障碍物
[*]超远射程：射程是普通弹弓的两倍，掌控更广阔的战场
[/list]合成配方在任意工作台合成：
[list]
[*]电池组 ×5
[*]铱锭 ×10
[/list]操作方式[list]
[*]鼠标左键：发射电能子弹
[*]V键：切换破坏模式
[/list]这款武器将《植物大战僵尸2》的怀旧美学与星露谷物语的战斗系统完美结合，拥有自定义子弹贴图和电弧特效。非常适合想要一款强力、有趣的远程武器的玩家！
